proposal:
SYNTHESIS OF THE REPOSITORY AS A REPRODUCIBLE RESEARCH ARTIFACT. Reconstructed from research/scout-explore.json and research/scout-challenge.json plus read-only verification of the committed notebook JSON, after the original synthesize stage produced no artifact. Nothing here was obtained by executing the notebook; the SEED-V data is absent from the repository.

WHAT THE ARTIFACT SHIPS. Two tracked files: README.md (overview, feature list, prerequisites, article citation and DOI) and process_seedv_raw_files_with_mne_from_drive.ipynb (43 cells: 33 code, 10 markdown). There is no requirements.txt, environment.yml, pyproject.toml, lockfile, test, CI, saved split, saved checkpoint, prediction vector, or results file. The README claims three architectures (ShallowFBCSPNet, Deep4Net, EEGNetv4), preprocessing, SEED-V training/evaluation and 'visualizations such as confusion matrices and loss curves', but records no number, no seed, no split definition and no environment pin.

VERIFIED PIPELINE FACTS (cell indices 0-based). Cell 5: %pip install mne (unpinned) and braindecode==0.8; cell 6: uninstall braindecode, then install braindecode unpinned, whose recorded output resolves to braindecode-0.8.1; cell 7 prints numpy 1.26.4 / mne 1.8.0 while its comments claim 1.22.4 / 1.4.0; cell 4 prints Python 3.10.12 while notebook metadata says 3.8.10. Cell 8 mounts Google Drive and cell 9 hardcodes shared-drive paths (6 occurrences of /content/drive, 1 drive.mount). Cell 15 and cell 27 have their .save(...) calls commented out, yet cells 25 and 29 read the processed/ and labeled/ directories those saves would create, so the committed notebook cannot regenerate its own inputs. Cell 27 builds epoch metadata from 15-entry session lists while the recorded outputs in cell 32 contain 12 events per file. Cell 33 windows a 50 s epoch with a 50 s window and a 0.01 s stride, and cell 35's summary output shows input [-1, 62, 10000, 1], so exactly one 10,000-sample window per trial is produced and the stride is inert. Cell 37 computes train_samples=floor(0.8*N), testList=range(train_samples+1, N), and a validation split with train_test_split(test_size=0.2, shuffle=False) over range(N); it then reassigns train_set=windows_dataset, discarding the declared splits['train']. Cell 38's recorded history is 100 epochs with train_accuracy=valid_accuracy=0.25 in every row and negative NLL losses (first row -523.59 / -2314.25, last row -753061.71 / -651607.26). Cell 39 records 'Test acc: 24.35%' and timestamp 1724185416. All 43 cells have execution_count=null. The source contains zero occurrences of manual_seed, np.random.seed, random.seed or random_state, and the file order comes from three unsorted os.listdir calls (0 hits for sorted(os.listdir)).

VERIFIED NUMBERS. Cell 32's 48 printed label vectors contain 48 x 12 = 576 trials with class counts Disgust 144, Fear 96, Sad 112, Neutral 144, Happy 80. With N=576: train=460 (0..459), val=116 (460..575), test=115 (461..575); val and test share 115 indices, i.e. 100% of test is inside validation, and index 460 is validation-only. The identity testList = val minus {460} holds for every N>=6 (exact arithmetic; for N=576 it is 115/115). The constant 'predict Neutral' rule scores 115/460 = 25.00% on train, 29/116 = 25.00% on val and 28/115 = 24.35% on test, reproducing the three recorded figures exactly; the per-slice majority is Neutral on train and val but Disgust on test (29/115 = 25.22%). Exact binomial p for 28/115 is 0.244 against chance (0.20) and 0.915 against 29/115; Wilson 95% CI is [17.4%, 32.9%].

GAP RANKING (impact on the artifact's ability to support the article). 1. NO HELD-OUT EVALUATION (fatal). Validation and test coincide, so every reported test accuracy is a validation re-measurement and model/hyper-parameter selection has already seen it. No split artifact is saved, so the leak cannot even be audited post hoc. This alone invalidates the only quantitative output in the repository. 2. RECORDED RESULT IS NULL-COMPATIBLE (fatal to interpretation). The single recorded number equals the constant-Neutral baseline to the digit, is below the test-slice majority, and cannot be distinguished from chance; with 1 run, no seed, no repeat and no CI, the repository cannot show that learning occurred. 3. LOSS IS NOT A VALID OBJECTIVE (fatal to the training claim). torch.nn.NLLLoss is applied to raw EEGNetv4 logits with no LogSoftmax, and the recorded losses are negative and diverge to about -7.5e5; a proper NLL is non-negative, so every loss curve and the README's 'loss curves' feature are meaningless. 4. SPLIT IS UNSEEDED AND SUBJECT-LEAKY (blocks reproducibility and independence). Zero seeding, order from unsorted os.listdir, no stratification, no subject grouping; the 460 boundary falls inside the 12-epoch block of session file #39 (indices 456..467), so one subject/session contributes to both train and val, and with 16 subject groups the recorded test is drawn from groups 12..15 which are entirely inside val. 5. ENVIRONMENT IS MUTABLE (blocks independent re-run). mne unpinned, braindecode installed at 0.8 then replaced by 0.8.1, no lockfile, and README/comment version claims that contradict the recorded outputs. 6. DATA ACCESS IS PRIVATE AND COUPLED TO COLAB (blocks reproduction). Six absolute /content/drive paths point at a private shared drive, no download instructions, checksum, license note or subject/session inventory is shipped, and the notebook cannot run outside Colab without edits. 7. PROVENANCE IS WEAK (limits auditability). All execution_count values are null, the recorded timestamp (2024-08-20) predates the import commit (2024-08-31), the recorded artifacts cannot be regenerated by the committed code (commented saves; 15-row metadata vs 12 recorded events), and the notebook contains no statement of what the article reports, so any notebook-vs-article comparison would require the paper and is out of scope for this repository-only review.

RANKING RATIONALE. Items 1-3 decide whether any number is meaningful; item 4 decides whether the split can be reconstructed and decides independence between partitions; items 5-6 decide whether anyone else can re-run; item 7 decides whether a reader can tell what was run. The single highest-value, minimal, evidence-adoptable fix is therefore the evaluation split: replace the cell-37 index arithmetic with a seeded, subject-grouped, disjoint train/val/test partition built from the metadata['subject'] column that cell 27 already writes, and fail fast if the three index sets intersect. That fix is local (one cell), needs no new data, and can be verified statically and by a pure-Python reimplementation; the baseline and loss defects remain separate follow-ups and must not be silently bundled into it.
next_steps: Adopt the split fix as the retained improvement: one seeded (fixed integer seed) function that partitions trial indices into disjoint train/val/test using metadata['subject'] groups, with 60/20/20 targets, deterministic given the seed, and an assertion that the three sets are pairwise disjoint and cover 0..N-1.

Verify the current split's failure read-only before proposing it: recompute train=range(0,floor(0.8N)), val=range(floor(0.8N),N), test=range(floor(0.8N)+1,N); assert test is a subset of val for every N>=6 and record 115/115 overlap at N=576.

Quantify the subject leak from the committed evidence: 576 trials / 48 session files = 12 epochs per file, so the 460 boundary falls inside file #39 (indices 456..467); with 16 subject groups, group 12 straddles train and val and groups 12..15 lie entirely inside val.

Validate any replacement against a stated contract over inputs N=0..1000 (partition, disjointness, coverage, 10-30% val and test for N>=10) and demonstrate that the notebook's current construction fails it while the seeded grouped replacement satisfies all inputs.
Show the fix is deterministic: same seed -> identical partition; different seed -> different partition; no subject group may appear in more than one partition.

Keep the cost honest: measure the replacement's runtime on a 100,000-trial synthetic input (best of 5) and report it against the current construction's runtime, without claiming any measurement of model accuracy.

Do not bundle the null-baseline or loss fixes into the retained split change: report separately that 28/115 = 24.35% is exactly the constant-Neutral baseline and that NLLLoss/logit mismatch makes the recorded losses negative, as justification for follow-up work.

Keep the provenance caveats explicit: N=576 is inferred from committed outputs (48 vectors x 12), outputs are stale (execution_count null, timestamp 2024-08-20), and nothing was executed, so no performance claim may be made.

Hand the Reviewer the acceptance criteria: the improvement must be one cell-local split change, justified by exact arithmetic and static notebook evidence, with no claim of reproduced accuracy and no unverified statement about the published article's numbers.
